description: Header file defining Vulkan descriptor set management classes and structures for the ATen native Vulkan API implementation.

classes.name: DescriptorSet
classes.description: Manages individual Vulkan descriptor sets, allowing binding of buffers and images.

classes.name: DescriptorSetPile
classes.description: Manages a pool of descriptor sets for efficient allocation.

classes.name: DescriptorPool
classes.description: Handles creation and management of Vulkan descriptor pools.

classes.name: DescriptorPoolConfig
classes.description: Configuration structure for descriptor pool parameters.

methods.name: DescriptorSet::bind
methods.description: Binds a VulkanBuffer or VulkanImage to the descriptor set at a specified binding index.

methods.name: DescriptorSet::get_bind_handle
methods.description: Returns the Vulkan descriptor set handle.

methods.name: DescriptorSet::add_binding
methods.description: Adds a resource binding to the descriptor set.

methods.name: DescriptorSetPile::get_descriptor_set
methods.description: Retrieves a descriptor set from the pile.

methods.name: DescriptorSetPile::allocate_new_batch
methods.description: Allocates a new batch of descriptor sets.

methods.name: DescriptorPool::init
methods.description: Initializes the descriptor pool with the given configuration.

methods.name: DescriptorPool::get_descriptor_set
methods.description: Allocates and returns a descriptor set with specified layout and signature.

methods.name: DescriptorPool::flush
methods.description: Flushes the descriptor pool, releasing resources.
